Name: ticket_1
Line: You. Programmer. The legacy system threw again overnight. Fix it before I have to explain it to anyone. And you do it by hand — I'm not paying a senior developer to ask a machine.

Name: power_vision_1
Line: You. Programmer. Whatever you think you just did, the walls are where they have always been. Do the ticket.

Name: final_1
Line: You. Programmer. I said it would never replace a senior developer. I did not say what it would do for one. There is no ticket today. Build whatever you like.
